subject: RE: error message on measEq.syntax() using repeated measures

messages.author: ce2d8f835a918736
messages.subject: RE: error message on measEq.syntax() using repeated measures
parts:
Hello,

I am trying to test MI using measEq.syntax() for repeated measures and here is my lavaan syntax: 

mod.cat<-' F1 =~ EmoWB1_1 + EmoWB2_1 + EmoWB3_1 
           F2 =~ EmoWB1_2 + EmoWB2_2 + EmoWB3_2
           F3 =~ EmoWB1_3 + EmoWB2_3 + EmoWB3_3
           F4 =~ EmoWB1_4 + EmoWB2_4 + EmoWB3_4
           F5 =~ EmoWB1_5 + EmoWB2_5 + EmoWB3_5
           F6 =~ EmoWB1_6 + EmoWB2_6 + EmoWB3_6
'
fit <- cfa(mod.cat, data = mydata)
summary(fit, fit.measures = TRUE)
standardizedSolution(fit)

longFacNames<-list(F=c("F1","F2","F3", "F4", "F5", "F6"))
baseline <- measEq.syntax(configural.model = mod.cat, data = mydata,
                          ordered = c("EmoWB1_1","EmoWB2_1","EmoWB3_1",
                                      "EmoWB1_2","EmoWB2_2","EmoWB3_2",
                                      "EmoWB1_3","EmoWB2_3","EmoWB3_3",
                                      "EmoWB1_4","EmoWB2_4","EmoWB3_4",
                                      "EmoWB1_5","EmoWB2_5","EmoWB3_5",
                                      "EmoWB1_6","EmoWB2_6","EmoWB3_6"),
                          parameterization = "theta", ID.fac = "std.lv", 
                          ID.cat = "Wu.Estabrook.2016",  
                          longFacNames = longFacNames) 
summary(baseline)

then I got this error message: 
Error in lav_samplestats_step1(Y = Data, wt = wt, ov.names = ov.names, : lavaan ERROR: some categories of variable `EmoWB1_1' are empty in group 1; frequencies are [13 34 23 5 0]

However, when I fit the model using cfa and it worked ... didn't generate any error messages. I am puzzled about the part where it says " ... in group 1"  does this imply that I need to specify groups when using measEq.syntax() ? For this analysis, there is no grouping variable. 

I'd greatly appreciate your help!

-tingting

messages.author: 3fe90052fbf2f899
messages.subject: Re: error message on measEq.syntax() using repeated measures
parts: However, when I fit the model using cfa and it worked

Because you did not declare any variables as ordered=, whereas you did so in the measEq.syntax() call.  The error is from lavaan, and it is fully informative.  You can collapse categories to avoid it.

Terrence D. Jorgensen
Assistant Professor, Methods and Statistics
Research Institute for Child Development and Education, the University of Amsterdam
